items.q: What types of clutter do you remove?
a: We remove all clutter, furniture, appliances, boxes, old toys, electronics, yard waste, and more. From single items to whole-house cleanouts, we take anything you don’t want. No job too big or small!

items.q: Do I need to sort my items before pickup?
a: Nope! We handle sorting for you. Just point out what stays or goes. We’ll separate recyclables, donations, and trash. Save time, we do the heavy lifting.

items.q: How much does clutter removal cost?
a: Prices depend on volume. We give free upfront quotes, no surprises. Small loads start at $125, with discounts for bulk. Book online for instant estimates!

items.q: What areas do you serve for clutter removal?
a: We cover GTA and nearby areas. Enter your zip online for instant service confirmation. Rural? Call us, we often extend further!

items.q: Can I schedule same-day clutter removal?
a: Yes! Call/text by noon for same-day service (subject to availability). Perfect for urgent moves, rentals, or sudden cleanouts. Fast response guaranteed.
